text.text_excerpt: LOVE LOVE LOVE this place. Some of the best quiche I've ever had, and their pies are amazing too -- fantastic coconut cream pie. Also love their mini pot-pies -- the coq-au-vin one was outstanding. And the owners are lovely. If you haven't been here yet, go!

Pros: variety of pies- both sweet and savory and a changing menu every week (look at their fb to see what they have today), the day old mystery box is a great deal! Pies and quiches made from scratch and really nice owners. Coffee shop inside that sells separate vegan pastries. Cons: first time I went I too thought it was pricey. I don't get to go as often as I would like, but I now think it is worth every penny. I have loved this place since it opened. At first I was on a mad search for the perfect crawfish pie- and let me tell you - this place has a good one. Pie Guy has a list of pies available each week. I am a little embarrassed that I have tried so many. But not really because they ...

Oh my. I was wandering along Magazine thinking about dinner and I saw that this shop was open. I've been wanting to try them. And when I went inside they had a lump crabmeat mini quiche and it was OMG delicious. The chocolate silk pie is the stuff of dreams. I have a cherry pie too but I'm saving it for tomorrow. Yep this shop sells nothing but pies and quiches. And seriously their crusts are UHMAZING. It's a small shop and while they sell some drinks, there is no where to eat inside. Like the entire building (the shop is located at the back of the Uptown Delivery Pharmacy), there seems to be renovations happening. There is a small parking lot adjacent to the building.
